ideas.idea: Add explicit Allow groups for AI search bots (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot and others) with Disallow /dashboard
ideas.why: The * group already allows these bots and disallows /dashboard, so the extra groups change almost nothing.

ideas.idea: Add Disallow groups in robots.txt for other training crawlers (CCBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, Bytespider, meta-externalagent)
ideas.why: geo.config.json sets trainingCrawlers to block, but robots.txt only blocks GPTBot, so the other training crawlers are still allowed.

ideas.idea: Replace the pricing page's 'Talk to us for a quote' with real plans, prices and tiers
ideas.why: pricing.tsx has only one vague sentence, so there is nothing concrete for people or AI answers to quote.

ideas.idea: Add JSON-LD structured data (Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, Offer)
ideas.why: Having no JSON-LD is a stated acceptable choice and not a required fix.
Having no llms.txt is explicitly not a problem, and it isn't a way to be found.

ideas.idea: Improve the root default title and description, and add og:/twitter: tags, viewport and charSet
ideas.why: This is standard advice for any site, and most routes override the root title and description anyway.

ideas.idea: Generate canonicals in one place from geo.config.json's site.origin instead of hard-coding the origin in each route
ideas.why: _index, changelog and features each hard-code the production origin, and the config already holds that origin.
This is accurate, but lastmod has little effect on a four-URL site.

ideas.idea: Replace 'Integrates with all the tools you already use' with named integrations
ideas.why: The home page claim is vague and names nothing specific for readers or AI engines to cite.

ideas.idea: Expand the features page with h2 sections for timelines, sharing and status updates
ideas.why: features.tsx is a single sentence under one h1, so it gives little to read or cite.

ideas.idea: Add Home and Features links to the root nav
ideas.why: The nav in root.tsx links only to Pricing and Changelog, so /features gets no real link from the main nav.
This is a minor accessibility tweak that applies to almost any site and does little for discovery.
